completion_notes: Comment model already existed in prisma/schema.prisma with PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED status

PATCH /api/comments/[id] updates comment status (admin, auth required)

Admin comments page at src/app/admin/(admin)/comments/page.tsx with status tabs and action buttons
